text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research article that focuses primarily on future land-use change prediction along the Silk Road countries, which are disaggregated into nine national/subregional units. The study develops and applies integrated system dynamics (SD) and cellular automata-artificial neural network (CA-ANN) spatial models at 300 m resolution to simulate land-use change from 2020 to 2030 under four distinct sustainable development goal (SDG) scenarios, with quantitative comparisons among scenarios. The paper provides spatially explicit land-use projections (urban, cultivated land, forest, grassland), includes quantitative accuracy metrics for the models (e.g., kappa coefficient 0.77 for CA-ANN, SD model error <5%), and analyzes mapped outputs and change rates. The study also assesses impacts of land-use change on terrestrial carbon stocks. The methodology and results confirm explicit national/subregional scale spatial modeling with multiple future scenarios and quantitative evaluation, meeting all core inclusion criteria. The focus is clearly on LULC prediction, not incidental or secondary use. Therefore, the paper fits the 'OK' category.)
